item.mynethersdelight.hotdog_with_mixed_: Hoglin Hot Dog with Mixed Salad
item.mynethersdelight.hotdog_with_nether: Hoglin Hot Dog with Nether Salad
lore.mynethersdelight.plate_of_striderlo: A serving of Striderloaf. Place the Striderloaf next to lava or on a heat source and use a Bowl on it to take a serving.
lore.mynethersdelight.striderloaf_block: A roast Strider that stays hot next to lava or on a heat source and cools off anywhere else. Place it and use a Bowl on it to take each of its 4 servings.
lore.mynethersdelight.plate_of_cold_stri: A serving of Cold Striderloaf. A placed Striderloaf cools off away from lava and heat; use a Bowl on it then to take a serving.
lore.mynethersdelight.cold_striderloaf_b: A Striderloaf left to cool away from lava and heat; break it before taking any servings to pick it up. Place it and use a Bowl on it to take each of its 4 servings.
lore.mynethersdelight.plate_of_ghasta_wi: A serving of Ghasta with Cream. Place the Ghasta with Cream and use a Bowl on it to take a serving.
lore.mynethersdelight.ghasta_with_cream_: A Ghasta feast that slowly grows back while at least 2 servings are left. Place it and use a Bowl on it to take each of its 4 servings.
lore.mynethersdelight.magma_cake_slice: A slice of Magma Cake. Use a Knife on a placed Magma Cake to cut a slice, or cut the whole cake on a Cutting Board.
lore.mynethersdelight.magma_cake_block: A fiery cake that burns anyone who walks on it. Place it and use a Knife on it to cut 7 slices.
lore.mynethersdelight.stuffed_hoglin: A whole roasted Hoglin that takes up two blocks. Place it, cut off its 2 ears with a Knife, then use a Bowl on it to take its 9 servings.
lore.mynethersdelight.roast_ear: A crispy ear from a Stuffed Hoglin. Use a Knife on a placed Stuffed Hoglin to cut off one of its 2 ears.
lore.mynethersdelight.plate_of_stuffed_h: The first serving of a Stuffed Hoglin. Cut both ears off a placed Stuffed Hoglin with a Knife, then use a Bowl on it to take the snout.
A serving of Stuffed Hoglin Ham. Once the snout is gone, use a Bowl on a placed Stuffed Hoglin to take one of its 4 ham servings.
A serving of Stuffed Hoglin. Once the ham is gone, use a Bowl on a placed Stuffed Hoglin to take one of its last 4 servings.
